source_incident: AgentMIM forum images were still not auto-created on new forum posts even after the forum image auto-QA remediation objective reported local implementation success.
lesson: Do not mark an objective complete because a helper, remediation runner, or side path exists. Validate the live operator-facing creation/execution path that produces the outcome Dave actually sees.
why_it_matters: The forum image objective built a remediation runner and quality gates, but new post creation could still publish placeholder/local-cover images. The missing validation was the normal create-post publish path.

reusable_rule.name: live_path_completion_proof_required
required_evidence: fresh artifact or database evidence confirms the visible outcome
side-runner success is not used as sole completion proof

forum_image_specific_takeaway.bad_completion_signal: Forum image remediation runner exists and local tests pass.
forum_image_specific_takeaway.good_completion_signal: Creating a fresh forum post automatically produces an image_generation_status of ai_generated or a specific explicit blocker, and the forum UI no longer shows a placeholder card for that new post.
forum_image_specific_takeaway.fix_committed: E:/comm_app commit 761cafd8 Generate forum editorial images on publish

operator_summary: MIM/TOD should treat this as training: completion requires proving the live path Dave sees, not only proving a cleanup or helper path.
